notes.text: The notice abbreviates Ami's title. The stored Davidson Eruvin 59b explicitly has Rav Ami bar Ada of Harpanya, supporting Rav Ami and the son direction for this occurrence. Ada remains untitled; the older Rabbi expansion is superseded.
